g.text: F Every mouse deletion | both methods
Additional cohorts reveal control-dependent and glial RNA signals
Primary count reanalysis: RR23 cerebellum (26 mice) and MHU-3 cerebrum (24 mice). Expanded 1,812-test family includes two additional cerebral-region analyses.
A/B/D: each point is one mouse; bars show means. C/E: limma/voom 95% moderated intervals. C/F: circles = limma/voom; squares = edgeR QL; filled = full-family q < 0.05.
F: 26 or 24 deletion estimates per method. AIM2 survives every deletion in the expanded family. SLC1A3, S100B and PYCARD retain direction; corrected support varies with deletion.
RR23 collection date differs by flight/control; narrative and ISA disagree for vivarium. Current MHU-3 has six KO-flight samples, versus five in the paper caption; all KO deletions were tested.
